notes: «- وهو ابن هارون -» is an editor gloss, left out. «عن الزهري، ومحمد بن علي، عن يزيد بن هرمز» : the two co-transmitters share one level, both from Yazid (rule 2).

Najda is the asker of the letter «كتب نجدة إلى ابن عباس يسأله»: the asker is a link (rule 5), and Ibn Abbas, who answers, is the last link (rule 6). The RWY reading omits Najda; the text names him, so he is kept.
